title: Peacemaker: Glorious Princess
description:
PEACEMAKER SERIES
The following games are part of the Peacemaker Series and they can be seen as one big story. However, each is designed so that they can be played separately without affecting your understanding of the individual plots. All of the games in this series are short yet solid JRPGs with morally gray characters, featuring plots with depth and thought-provoking themes.
• Hero King Quest: Peacemaker Prologue (2022)

• Peacemaker: Glorious Princess (2024)

• Peacemaker: Bloody Emperor (2026)

Об игреA classic JRPG. Play the role of a surviving princess. Gather companions, save the kingdom, make peace, and uncover the hidden truth in a desperate situation.

Features

Choose the difficulty mode to match your playing style 
Do you just want to enjoy getting through the story or are you eager to challenge mighty foes? This game's difficulty modes range from Combat-free Mode to Extreme Mode to meet different playing styles! 

Turn-based combat without the grind 
No grinding or item farming! Winning in combat relies on strategy, so put the strengths of your allies to good use and exploit the weaknesses of your enemies! 

Immersive camerawork in 2.5D
This game features 2.5D camerawork for more immersive storytelling.
